title: READY TO SEND is at 35 and nothing has been approved in 5 runs
summary: The pipeline has built and QA-passed 35 cards that no one has authorised. Steps 7-9 have now been starved five consecutive runs. Two decisions unstick it; the second one is about whether we keep filling the queue meanwhile.

payload.title: How do you want to drain the approval queue?

questions.prompt: 35 cards are QA-passed with verified-live mockups, waiting on your send authorisation. How do you want to clear them?
questions.helpText: All 35 passed the brand gate (14/14 on today's batch, independently re-run by QA from a fresh clone) and every mockup was content-verified live. The blocker is authorisation, not quality. Nothing has moved from READY TO SEND to APPROVED since the derma batch.

options.label: Bulk-approve by niche
options.description: I approve a whole niche at a time (auto repair, derma, dental, plumbing) after skimming a one-line-per-card digest. Fastest path; ~20 minutes for all 35.

options.label: Send me the best 10 first
options.description: Agents pick the 10 strongest cards, I approve just those this week, and we see reply rates before authorising the rest.

options.label: Card by card, no bulk
options.description: I want to read each one. Accepting that the queue drains slower than it fills.

options.label: Something else
options.description: Tell us how you want to handle it.

questions.prompt: While the queue is undrained, should the daily run keep generating leads and building mockups at full quota?
questions.helpText: The front half added 12 cards today and READY TO SEND has grown 17 to 23 to 35 across three runs. PIPELINE-CONFIG.md says a run should flag a queue growing three runs running rather than keep filling it. This is your call, not ours.

options.label: Keep running at full quota
options.description: Keep 3 PH + 1 international per day. I will drain the queue on my side.

options.label: Throttle the front half until the queue is under 10
options.description: Pause lead-gen and building; agents spend the run on tooling debt and follow-ups instead. Resume full quota once READY TO SEND is under 10.

options.label: Half quota until it is under 20
options.description: Keep the pipeline warm at a reduced rate rather than stopping it.

questions.prompt: Custom Cakes by Bam has been waiting four weeks with an approved draft that was never sent. Send it or drop it?
questions.helpText: It is the sole card in SYNCED TO GHL (SEND MANUALLY), its GHL opportunity is still at stage New Lead, and its due date is two days overdue while measuring nothing, because nothing was ever sent. Facebook DMs cannot be automated, so this needs a human to press send.

options.label: Send it now
options.description: I will send the approved FB draft and move the card to CONTACTED so follow-up sweeps can see it.

options.label: Drop the lead
options.description: Four weeks is too cold. Archive the card and clear it out of the queue.

options.label: Rewrite it first
options.description: The draft is stale after four weeks. Have Outreach redraft before I send.
